package_info.package_versions: N/A (custom malware, not a public package)
package_info.why_malicious: The loader is designed to enable remote access to compromised systems, exfiltrate sensitive data, and is delivered via phishing and malicious documents targeting government and telecommunications organizations. Its sole purpose is cyberespionage.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (after user opens malicious document or executes loader)
execution_context.file_location: malicious document macro or custom loader binary

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: The loader establishes a connection to a C2 domain (e.g., bugiplaysec[.]com, marakanas[.]com) and sends system information and harvested credentials to the remote server.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code collects system information and credentials, then exfiltrates this data via HTTP(S) POST requests to attacker-controlled domains, enabling remote access and espionage.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code initiates outbound connections to suspicious domains and exfiltrates sensitive data without user consent.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal document loaders or macros should not collect system information or send data to external servers.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Remote support tools may collect system info, but only with user consent and to trusted domains.
key_indicators: Outbound HTTP(S) requests to known malicious domains
Harvesting and exfiltration of credentials/system info
Execution triggered by document open or loader run

execution_context.file_location: custom loader binary or dropped script

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: The loader downloads and executes additional payloads from URLs such as hxxps://applesaltbeauty[.]com/wordpress/wp-includes/widgets/classwp/521734i or hxxps://marakanas[.]com/Kkdn7862Jj6h2oDASGmpqU4Qq4q4.php.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code downloads secondary payloads from attacker infrastructure and executes them, enabling further compromise or persistence.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code fetches and executes remote code from untrusted sources, a common malware tactic.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate software should not download and execute code from unknown external URLs.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Software updaters may download updates, but only from trusted, verified sources.
key_indicators: Download and execution of code from suspicious URLs
No user interaction or consent for code execution
Use of obfuscated or non-standard URLs

attack_chain.action: Victim receives phishing email with malicious document or link to loader.
attack_chain.leads_to: User opens document or executes loader.

attack_chain.action: Malicious macro or loader executes, collecting system information and credentials.
attack_chain.leads_to: Data is exfiltrated to attacker-controlled C2 server.

attack_chain.action: Loader downloads and executes additional payloads from attacker infrastructure.
attack_chain.leads_to: Further compromise, persistence, or lateral movement.

behavioral_signatures: Malicious document macros or loaders making outbound HTTP(S) requests to suspicious domains
Harvesting and exfiltration of credentials or system information
Download and execution of secondary payloads from non-corporate URLs
file_indicators: Documents with embedded macros that initiate network connections
network_indicators: Connections to bugiplaysec[.]com, marakanas[.]com, ocs-romastassec[.]com, ocspdep[.]com, security-ocsp[.]com, troadsecow[.]com

Outbound requests to URLs such as hxxps://applesaltbeauty[.]com/wordpress/wp-includes/widgets/classwp/521734i, hxxps://marakanas[.]com/Kkdn7862Jj6h2oDASGmpqU4Qq4q4.php, hxxps://natply[.]com/wordpress/wp-includes/fonts/ch/097214o, hxxps://ocs-romastassec[.]com/goog_comredira3cf7ed34f8.php
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for documents or executables that initiate outbound connections to known Winter Vivern C2 domains or IPs, especially shortly after being opened or executed. Flag any process that downloads and executes code from non-corporate or suspicious URLs. Correlate file hashes of loader binaries with known IOCs. Alert on credential or system information exfiltration attempts to external servers.
